tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The four Duffer Golf folding golf simulator enclosures (Duffer 8 and Duffer 10, each as a System or a Complete): delivered price in US dollars, what each one includes, enclosure and room dimensions in inches, build and ship times, warranty, installation and financing. Read-only.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Will a Duffer fit a room? Give the room's width, depth and ceiling height in whole inches. Returns the verdict the duffergolf.net fit checker shows (fits, tight, ask or no), the same verdict for each model, and which number is short. Read-only: it sends nothing to anyone.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Duffer Golf's FAQ, answered by Tate Mauck, who builds them. Pass query to keep only entries that share a word with it (case-insensitive, best matches first); omit it for every entry.

tools.name: find_dealers
tools.description: Approved Duffer dealers (shops that sell it, offer local pickup or install it), optionally only those located in or serving one US state. With no dealer nearby, Duffer Golf sells direct and ships to every state. Read-only.

tools.name: contact_info
tools.description: How to reach Duffer Golf: email, where it is, how fast Tate answers, and the links to the contact, reserve, shop and checkout pages. Read-only: it does not send a message or place an order.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contact_info · Private data: contact_info · Public sink: get_faq, contact_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contact_info · Private data: contact_info · Public sink: get_faq, contact_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
